title: Compact BYO-CIDR Onboarding + Diagnostics Overlay
creator: Maya Patel
description: Design a compact, mobile-friendly quickstart flow for customers who bring their own CIDR ranges (BYO-CIDR). Deliver a set of annotated screenshots and a lightweight diagnostics overlay that surfaces routing issues, IP conflicts, and retry guidance during install and upgrades. Focus on minimal cognitive load for SREs and platform engineers while preserving links to deeper docs and downloadable network templates.
acceptance_criteria: A1: A 6-step compact quickstart flow (desktop + mobile breakpoints) that fits within the Console onboarding modal
A2: Diagnostics overlay with 5 common error states, each with suggested next actions and a link to a curated troubleshooting doc
A3: Annotated PNGs and screen-optimized SVGs exported for the docs site and in-product help
A4: UX copy vetted by security and legal for CIDR/IP guidance
A5: Hand-off package (Figma file, redlines, export kit) uploaded to Drive and linked in the ticket
comments: 2026-02-20 Maya Patel: Initial ticket created. Scope: compact modal-based quickstart + diagnostics overlay; target release private-vpc-2026.03.
2026-02-25 Liam O'Connor: Wireframes uploaded to Figma, focused on a 6-step condensed stepper. Decision: collapse advanced CIDR options into an 'Advanced' drawer to reduce first-run friction.
2026-02-28 Security Review: flagged copy about CIDR ranges; requested non-actionable phrasing and an explicit link to company's acceptable IP usage doc. Action: update copy and rerun review.

2026-03-03 Engineering (ENG-47821): Backend team can provide a diagnostic API endpoint that returns structured error codes for IP conflicts and route mismatches. Depend on ENG-47821 for real-time validation. Suggested UI show code and a copyable debug snippet.

2026-03-06 Design review: PM requested smaller screenshots for in-product help panel; accessibility review suggests 4.5:1 contrast on overlay CTAs. Adjusted color tokens and exported high-contrast variants.

2026-03-09 Liam O'Connor: Prototype validated in staging with 3 SREs. Feedback: need an escape hatch to skip CIDR validation for air-gapped installs and clearer messaging on auto-assigned ephemeral ranges. Added 'Skip validation' secondary action in step 3.
2026-03-12 UX copy pass by Maya Patel and legal approval confirmed. Preparing export kit and documentation references for hand-off. Added follow-up ticket for localization: DES-90402.

2026-03-13 Liam O'Connor: Assets exported and uploaded to Drive; PR for docs site created (see related_prs). Marking visuals ready for engineering implementation but keeping ticket open for follow-up QA screenshots during rollout.
notes: Trade-offs: Keeping the flow compact reduces onboarding friction but hides advanced configuration behind a drawer; plan to surface advanced telemetry in Console's Network page.
Follow-up: capture real-world error frequency after 2 weeks of rollout to decide if additional inline remediation steps are needed.
Localization: strings scoped for translation; create localization ticket DES-90402 before final release.
